name: Untrusted Project Mode
description: When opening a project from an untrusted source (downloaded, external drive, unknown origin), the application enters restricted mode: no network, no filesystem writes outside project, no process spawn, limited extension capabilities.
purpose: Protect the system from malicious projects by automatically restricting capabilities when opening untrusted content, preventing network access, filesystem writes, and process execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Untrusted source detection is implemented (download flag, extended attributes, user designation)
Untrusted mode restricts: no network egress, no filesystem writes outside project dir, no process spawn
Extensions run with reduced capabilities in untrusted mode
User is clearly notified that project is in restricted mode
User can explicitly trust a project to lift restrictions
Restricted mode violations produce security event receipts
